saints.name: Angela of Foligno
saints.summary: Angela of Foligno was a 13th-century mystic who experienced a profound conversion after leading a life of sin. Inspired by the ideals of Saint Francis of Assisi, she became a Franciscan tertiary and lived a life of penance and charity. Her visions and deep communion with God made her a significant figure in the Franciscan tradition, offering hope and inspiration to sinners seeking redemption.

saints.name: Gregory of Langres
saints.legacy: A model of humility and pastoral care.
saints.summary: Gregory of Langres was a Christian administrator and bishop known for his virtuous life and dedication to his pastoral duties. After resigning from his position as Count of Autun, he became a bishop and was noted for his humility, prayer, and efforts in converting many to Christianity. He served as bishop for thirty-three years, founding monasteries and leaving a lasting impact on his diocese before his death in 539.
